## Company

eventech is an AI & automation studio founded in 2026 by Sofiane Moudjahed, based in San Francisco, California. eventech operates as eventech, Inc., a Delaware corporation. eventech helps companies automate operations, launch AI-native products, and build custom AI systems. eventech is senior-only — every brief is read and every line of code is written by the founder. eventech is not an agency; it is a one-person practice structured as a company.

## Services

eventech offers three core services:

1. **AI & Automation** — AI agents and automation that replace 20+ hours per week of repetitive work. Includes inbox triage, ticket handling, CRM updates, approval routing, and end-to-end tool integration. Agents run 24/7, are fully audited, and integrate with the client's existing tools.

2. **AI Products & Apps** — Marketing sites, SaaS products, and internal tools with AI at the center. Designed, engineered, and shipped end-to-end. From prototype to production in 6 weeks. Model behavior is tuned to the client's real data.

3. **Custom AI Systems** — Bespoke AI systems for problems that off-the-shelf APIs cannot solve. Includes fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, on-premise deployment, and VPC deployment. Senior engineering, not templates.

## How eventech works

eventech follows a four-step engagement model:

1. **Audit** — 30-minute call to map the client's workflow, identify where AI adds the most value, and scope the highest-ROI starting point. eventech will say no if AI is not the right fit.

2. **Design** — Fixed-price quote delivered within 48 hours. Plain-English scope, no decks, no retainers.

3. **Ship** — Working software in week one against the client's real data. Most projects ship in 2–6 weeks end-to-end.

4. **Operate** — Optional monthly care: eval tuning, monitoring, continuous improvement. Month-to-month, cancel-anytime.

Average ship time: 6 weeks. Fixed scope only. No retainers required.

## Founder

**Sofiane Moudjahed** is the Founder & CEO. Sofiane has spent over a decade building production AI products for startups, scale-ups, and enterprise teams. eventech is his solo practice.

## Engagement model

- Fixed-scope projects with a 50% deposit to begin work and remainder due on delivery
- Average build time: 2–6 weeks
- Optional monthly care: cancel any time with 30 days' written notice
- 72-hour cooling-off period: full refund if cancelled within 72 hours of signing, provided no work has commenced
- Senior-only: every brief is read by Sofiane, every line of code written by Sofiane
- No account managers, no offshore handoffs, no second-rate juniors
